CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steve Talt, Mayor  www.CityofSanMarino.org
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 08, 2023 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.CityofSanMarino.org/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until
  3:00 p.m. the day of the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public
  comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time, and
  previously distributed public comment will be noted. Any comments received after

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 08, 2023  PAGE 1 of 5
   3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the
  meeting.
  Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us webinar module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor
Huang, and Mayor Talt

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READINGS

This action permits the City Council to act on ordinances and resolutions without having to
read the entire text of the ordinance or resolution. The title of an ordinance on First
Reading must be read in its entirety. An ordinance on Second Reading does not require
having the title read. However, the City Council may request that an ordinance or
resolution be read in its entirety before taking any action.

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 08, 2023  PAGE 2 of 5
   PRESENTATION

 FAMILY COURT AWARENESS MONTH NOVEMBER 2023

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

 1.  PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-
  23-1409 (FIRST READING) ADDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION
  23.05.03 REGARDING DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS AND OBJECTIVE
  DESIGN  STANDARDS  FOR  MULTI-FAMILY  RESIDENTIAL
  DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS IN THE HISTORICAL AND CULTURAL ZONE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council conduct a public hearing and
  introduce for first reading Ordinance No. O-23-1409. If the City Council agrees, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to waive full reading and introduce by title only Ordinance No. O-23- 1409,
  an Ordinance of the San Marino City Council adding San Marino Municipal Code
  Section 23.05.03 regarding development standards and objective design standards
  for multi-family residential development projects in the Historical and Cultural Zone.”

  NEW BUSINESS

 2.  CONSIDERATION OF APPEAL FOR THE APPROVAL OF CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT NO. CUP 22-05 AT 2277 HUNTINGTON DRIVE TO
  DETERMINE THE PARKING REQUIREMENT AT A PROPOSED
  RESTAURANT (EL DORADO)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council affirm the adoption of Planning
  Commission Resolution No. PCR 2308. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt City Council Resolution No. 23-30 affirming the adoption of Planning
  Commission Resolution No. PCR 23-08 approving Conditional Use Permit Number CUP
  22-05 at 2277 Huntington Drive to determine the parking requirement and to provide
  alcohol sales and consumption at a proposed restaurant- El Dorado.”

 3.  APPROVAL OF A THREE-YEAR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT
  WITH OPENGOV FOR ELECTRONIC PROCUREMENT AND CONTRACT
  MANAGEMENT PLATFORM SERVICES IN A TOTAL AMOUNT OF
  $71,200

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve a three-year
  professional services agreement with OpenGov for electronic procurement and
  contract management software services and appropriate funds in the amount of

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 08, 2023  PAGE 3 of 5
   $28,217 in support of this agreement. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve a three-year professional services agreement with OpenGov for
  electronic procurement and contract management software services in a total amount
  of $71,200, authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the
  City, and appropriate an additional $28,217 to account #101-09-4150-0500 (Other
  Contract Services – IT). ”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Council approve the minutes of the
  special meeting of October 11, 2023, the regular meeting of October 11, 2023, the
  joint City Council and Public Safety Commission meeting of October 27, 2023, the
  adjourned regular meeting of October 27, 2023, and the special meeting of October
  27, 2023. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to approve the minutes of the special meeting of October 11, 2023, the
  regular meeting of October 11, 2023, the joint City Council and Public Safety
  Commission meeting of October 27, 2023, the adjourned regular meeting of October
  27, 2023, and the special meeting of October 27, 2023.”

 5.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF SEPTEMBER
  2023

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of
  September 2023.”

 6.  RECEIVE AND  FILE  MONTHLY  DISBURSEMENTS  REPORT  FOR
  OCTOBER 2023

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of October 2023. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of
  October 2023.”

 7.  APPROVAL OF CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY CLOSURE CALENDAR FOR
  2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approval of the Crowell Public
  Library closure calendar for 2024. If the City Council concurs with staff’s

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 08, 2023  PAGE 4 of 5
   recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the Crowell Public Library closure calendar for 2024.”

 8.  LETTER OF AUTHORIZATION TO ALLOW SAN GABRIEL VALLEY
  COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS TO APPLY FOR THE CALRECYLE SB 1383
  LOCAL ASSISTANCE GRANT ON BEHALF OF THE CITY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to
  sign a Letter of Authorization allowing the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments
  (SGVCOG) to submit a regional application for Round Two of the SB 1383 Local
  Assistance Grant Program. If the Council concurs, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to authorize the City Manager to sign a Letter of Authorization allowing the
  San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments (SGVCOG) to submit a regional
  application for Round Two of the SB 1383 Local Assistance Grant Program on behalf
  of the City of San Marino”.

 9.  ADOPTION OF SIDE LETTER OF AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE SAN
  MARINO CITY EMPLOYEES' ASSOCIATION (“SMCEA”) AND THE CITY
  OF SAN MARINO (“CITY”) CONCERNING A 9/80 WORK SCHEDULE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the Side Letter of
  Agreement between the San Marino City Employees Association (“CEA”) and the City
  of San Marino (“City”).

  “I move to adopt the Side Letter of Agreement between the San Marino City
  Employees Association (“CEA”) and the City of San Marino (“City”) concerning a 9/80
  work schedule.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
